car-rush.title: Car Rush: Race Online for Free! Speed, Skill & Thrills Await
car-rush.slogan: Experience the ultimate speed challenge in Car Rush!
car-rush.description: Ready for high-speed action? Car Rush challenges you to race through exciting worlds, dodging obstacles and beating the clock. Master your driving skills in car-rush and compete for the fastest lap times. Play car-rush now and feel the rush!

HomeIframe.title: Car Rush
HomeIframe.description: Race your way through three worlds! Avoid obstacles and complete laps before time runs out in Car Rush!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Car Rush is an exhilarating racing game where you navigate challenging tracks across three unique worlds. Test your skills, avoid obstacles, and race against the clock!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the up arrow key to accelerate.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Use the down arrow key to brake and slow down.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Use the left and right arrow keys to turn the car.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Explore three diverse worlds with tracks designed to test your racing abilities.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Dodge various obstacles to maintain your speed and stay on course.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Complete all laps before the time runs out to achieve victory.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Enjoy Car Rush online on your mobile phone, tablet, or computer.
